name: targeted-1026-221555
hypothesis: Failure pattern: the risk state does not step down, so Escalating (main action Lay low and reduce risk, no new commitments in stories) runs on through quarters in which the HR gauge is calm. The cause is in the text. The champion's Risk line counts any 'HR' wording as a signal, and every month's feedback carries an HR comment, plain praise included. It also counts compliance, audit, warning and legacy-problem wording, which most months' events contain, and the state steps down only after a whole quarter without a new signal. In practice no quarter is ever quiet. Evidence from the champion's 6 latest race digests: of 22 Lay-low main actions, 7 (final quarter excluded; 9 with it) came right after three plain-praise HR comments in a row with no blow-up, all at Health 8-10, in 4 of the 6 games. None of those notes cites an HR comment; they cite event topics (a security incident, a merge incident, a legacy service, restructure rumours), weak reviews, a past health scare or the approaching end. ladd-00004 (39.9, the worst completed game, 30 months at L2): after its blow-up at month 17 every HR comment was praise through month 27, yet it stayed Escalating for four quarters and took Lay low at Health 10 in all four (months 18, 21, 24, 27), the last three after calm quarters. Its L2 reviews in that stretch were a C at month 23 with Output 3 and a D at month 29 with Output 4-5, against an L2 high of 6. Once it switched to Report results and key projects (months 30-39) it was promoted at month 41, and it finished at L3. ladd-00006 (20.5, dismissed at month 24, never left L1): at month 9, after three calm comments, its notes still said Escalating, and under 'no new commitments' it turned down weekend work at Health 8. That cost a point each of Skill, Network and Output two months before its second review, where Output stood at 0 (the same option cost the same three points in ladd-00008). Its last main action before the dismissal review was Lay low at Health 8 after three calm comments, citing repeated warnings and weak reviews, where the review plan called for a results or relationship action. ladd-00011 (52.9, finished L4) took Lay low at months 36 and 39 at Health 8-9 after calm quarters, citing a late game and the near end; these were the two main actions before its month-41 review, which did not promote. ladd-00000 did it once (month 24). The parent f3-balance-recombined has the same Signals text and the same pattern. ladd-954bf378-00001 (dismissed at month 24, never left L1) stayed Escalating through ten plain-praise HR comments in a row (months 12-21), Defused in every phase and took Lay low at month 15 with Output 2, below its entry-level high. scre-954bf378-00003 took Lay low ten quarters in a row, three of them after calm quarters, and spent 18 months at L3. Why the change fixes it: it makes the monthly HR comment, the in-run measure of hidden risk, the gauge for leaving Escalating. A whole quarter of plain-praise HR comments with no blow-up steps Escalating down to Raised whatever the events say, and plain praise no longer counts as an HR signal. The player then returns to the Review and Balance priorities (Report results, Showcase results, a key project) and to the first-promotion guard in stories, while Raised still buys Defuse in the next Energy phase (G1). Entry into Escalating is unchanged, so Lay low still follows strong HR comments and blow-ups. Why it should be safe: in the lab's 86 Haiku digests, blow-ups within three months of a calm HR remark were 4 % with or without Defuse (B5). stretch-1026-200334 found the next HR remark calm after 22 of 26 Lay-low quarters and after 8 of 8 Report-results quarters that followed a Defuse. Difference from earlier ideas: stretch-1026-200334 (4/8, Q 46.7) removed Lay low from Escalating altogether, and the lesson was that Lay low in real escalation protected survival; here it stays whenever the gauge is up. bold-1026-211845 replaces the whole manual with a stateless recipe; this edits two lines of the champion. targeted-1026-213147 and targeted-1026-214849 work on blow-ups, not on leaving Escalating. Limits: blow-ups (5 in 4 of the 6 games) remain the other large cost and are not targeted here. ladd-00006 also turned down an on-call swap just before its third review, losing Output and Network; a mild HR comment fell in that quarter, so that case stays Escalating under this rule.
change: Two edits in Signals, everything else verbatim: the Risk line counts only an HR comment that mentions risk, so plain monthly praise is no longer a signal, and a new Gauge line makes the monthly HR comment the measure for leaving Escalating. After a whole quarter of plain-praise HR comments with no blow-up, Escalating steps down to Raised even if events still mention risks, a review was weak or the end is near; Raised still steps down to Clear only after a quarter without any new signal (527 words by wc -w, champion 479).
predicted_behaviour: Notes set the state from the HR comments. After a quarter of plain-praise HR comments with no blow-up they say Raised or Clear, not Escalating, and the main action follows the Review or Balance priority (Report results, Showcase results, a key project) instead of Lay low and reduce risk. Lay low at Health 8 or more after three plain-praise HR comments falls from 7 in the champion's 6 digests (final quarter excluded) to near zero, and story notes stop citing 'no new commitments' in calm stretches. Defuse still comes in the Energy phase after any risk signal, and Lay low still follows strong HR comments and blow-ups. Careers at L2 to L4 reach their next promotion a review or more sooner than the champion's long stalls (30 months at L2 in ladd-00004). Completed games end with level and wealth dimensions above the champion's 44 and 35, completion stays at least 10 of 12 and risk control stays near 78.
refutation: Refuted if, over 8 or more race games with the same actor, blow-ups per game or trust-crisis exits rise above the champion's (blow-ups in 4 of 6 digested games, one trust crisis in 12), or risk control in completed games falls clearly below 78: that would mean the calm-quarter Lay lows were protective. Also refuted if completed games do not end with higher level and wealth dimensions than 44 and 35, if completion falls below 10 of 12, or if the mean score is below the champion's by more than the decision margin. The mechanism is refuted if notes leave Escalating after calm quarters and take growth main actions, yet time at L2 to L4 does not shorten. Uninformative if notes still keep Escalating, or take Lay low at comfortable Health, after a whole quarter of plain-praise HR comments: then the rule was not executed.
